anomaly_label: Data acquisition interruption and increase in pressure

evidence.observation: Heater temperature reads ~376-382 °C and creeps monotonically upward, physically implausible versus reboiler T703 ~55-61 °C
Reboiler only ~55-61 °C, far below boiling/column head expectations, with slow drift
Column section heaters oscillate in opposite directions (T708 down then up, T704/T706 down then up), no stable separation profile
Top sections flat at ~36 °C, no vapor breakthrough to the head

args.missing_evidence: A composition/GC measurement of distillate and bottoms, plus an independent check of T701 (heater thermocouple) calibration and confirmation of heater power setpoints
